additional_info.subject: Abertura de Chamado - Shell Recharge I Posto Décio (( Y2 R4 313020197005 ))
additional_info.body:
Boa tarde, tudo bem?
Estamos enfrentando um problema na IHM da estação Y2 R4 313020197005, localizada no Shell Recharge | Posto Décio – BR-153, Km 0 + 500 m, Bairro Liberdade, Araporã-MG.
Mesmo após a reinicialização do carregador, a IHM permanece inoperante. Ressaltamos que o carregador continua operando normalmente e realizando cargas, sendo a falha aparentemente apenas na IHM, que pode estar danificada.
Dessa forma, solicitamos, por gentileza, a
abertura de um chamado técnico
para tratativa e correção do problema.
Ficamos no aguardo.
Att.

additional_info.subject: ID0472078-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197005] HMI issue CRM:03276000016
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0472078
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-BR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / R3 313020197005
Charger ID / Serial No.:
REV5ab
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: HMI issue
▹ Please measure the Voltage between the 24V supply on the PCB, If the Voltage is between 24/25V and the HMI is OK: SCREENSHOT_DISPLAY_CONNECTION
▹
Verify if the DP cable is properly attached
If both are OK then replace the HMI
I will send you all the necessary references for the specific HMI required for this charger:
▹
PANEL_ID
8EM5902-1AA00-6AA1
▹
CONTROL_PANEL_ID
8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8
▹
Adapter
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-BR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
